description: Peek recent samples on a raw DDS topic as a `SampleResult`, like `sample_messages` but read from the DDS layer (works without ROS 2). `count` defaults to 5, clamped to 50. (a) The builtin discovery topics (`DCPSParticipant`, `DCPSSubscription`, `DCPSPublication`) return structured discovery records: on Cyclone the CURRENT state (one per live participant or endpoint), not recent events (use `participant_events`); `DCPSPublication` / `DCPSSubscription` are the raw data behind `list_endpoints`. The topic may be `/scan`, `scan` or `rt/scan`. (b) User topics: payload decoding is DISABLED on every backend, so the call returns `count` 0, empty `samples` and a `note`; that does NOT mean the topic is silent. Use `list_endpoints` for its presence, writers, readers and QoS. A user topic not announced on the bus raises an error. Right after start the call waits up to 3 s for discovery. **Read-only by architecture**: it cannot publish. **Raises an MCP error** when no DDS module is active or the topic is not announced. **Duration**: DDS binding behind the DDS lock, one call at a time; ends within 45 s; `busy` error if the lock is held (retry).

count.description: Messages to return, default 5, at most 50 (`health_check.max_sample_count`): more is capped to 50, negative raises an error. The result's `count` may be lower.

topic.description: DDS topic name: bare (`scan`), ROS 2 mangled (`rt/scan`) or a builtin discovery topic (`DCPSParticipant`, `DCPSSubscription`, `DCPSPublication`). Letters, digits, `_`, `/` and `::` only.

name: peek_dds_samples

payload.description: Message fields as nested values; `nan`/`inf` are strings. Live `sample_messages` adds `_truncated_fields` (cut paths) and `_raw_text` (unparsable output).

received_ns.description: Wall-clock ns when the `ros2` CLI printed the message (live `sample_messages` only).

recorded_ns.description: Bag record time in ns (`peek_bag_samples` only).

summary.description: Condensed reading of the whole message (see `summary_type`); `null` for other types and DDS peeks.

timestamp_ns.description: Publisher-clock ns: `header.stamp`, else the time in the body of `Clock`, `TFMessage` or `Log`, else 0 (see `stamp_source`); not the arrival time.

basis.description: Clock the rate is measured on: `received_ns` (live) or `recorded_ns` (bag).

clock_basis.description: Stamp clock: `wall` (stamps are dates), `sim` (since a start), `none` (no stamps), `mixed` (several kinds, e.g. two publishers).

interval_cv.description: Interval standard deviation over mean; `null` under 2 messages.

message_count.description: Messages the rate is computed from.

observed_frequency_hz.description: Messages per second on `basis`, drain excluded; the rate the caller received. `null` under 2 messages.

sim_frequency_hz.description: Same rate on the messages' own stamps (publisher clock); `null` without advancing stamps.

stamp_age_median_s.description: Median of arrival minus stamp, s, if `wall`; negative = publisher ahead.

stamp_age_p95_s.description: 95th percentile of that age (max under 20 messages).

stamp_regression_count.description: Times a stamp went back versus the previous one.

startup_burst_count.description: Leading messages set aside as a start-up drain (live only); still in `message_count`.

trailing_gap_s.description: Time from the last message to the end of a live observation; else `null`.

verdict.description: First match: `silent` (none), `insufficient` (under 5), `intermittent` (an interval over 3x the median), `stable` (cv < 0.2), `jittery` (< 0.5), `erratic`. Describes this window, not a diagnosis.

count.description: Number of samples in `samples`: fewer than requested when the topic gave fewer, never more than 50 (a larger request is capped to 50).

note.description: Why `samples` is empty or limited, when not obvious; else `None`.

rate.description: How the topic delivered the messages, with a verdict; `null` for `peek_dds_samples`. Use `count` >= 10.

title: Peek DDS samples
